concept.th-address.def: The number of a memory slot, which lets the program find that exact slot again.
concept.th-stack.def: The memory region for the values a function is using right now, where each call adds a frame on top that is removed automatically when the call ends.
concept.th-heap.def: The memory region for objects that must outlive the call that made them, kept until nothing refers to them.
concept.th-garbage-collector.def: The part that reclaims heap memory once nothing points to an object any more.
concept.th-volatile.def: A property of RAM: it is fast to reach but wiped the moment power drops.
